summary: Tested the PayPal checkout for gift cards and group bookings, the branded /pay page, the booking modal's paypal_checkout step, the meet-sign $7 change, Love Beach, removal of the share buttons and Google Wallet. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed. Gift purchase with pay_with=paypal returns code and total_charged=55.0 for a $50 card with no checkout_url. Gift create-order returns order_id and stores it. Unknown gift returns 404, unknown capture returns 404, and a bad pay_with returns 422. Group checkout with pay_with=paypal returns the deposit with no Stripe call, and payment_transactions.amount equals the deposit. Meet-sign and wharf-greeter add-ons are all $7. Google Wallet status is configured=false, and port-love-beach is $20. Frontend: /pay/CB-6N6MRQ26 shows the checkout steps (Trip details done, Payment current), the brand logo row, pay-stripe-btn, the yellow PayPal/Pay Later/Card buttons inside pay-paypal-buttons, the 'or other ways to pay' divider, Zelle and checkout-trust. There is no PayPal.me text and the 390px layout works. However, on the FIRST cold load in a fresh browser the PayPal SDK throws 'zoid destroyed all components'. The CRA 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay appears and no PayPal button renders (0 visible frames). This happened on 3 of 3 cold loads; reloads render fine. Booking modal: choosing pay-method-paypal-checkout gives the label 'Continue to PayPal', and submitting reserves the booking and shows paypal-checkout-step with the yellow button. /gift-cards: the toggle works, the label reads 'Continue to PayPal · $55.00', and after submit the PayPal block replaces the submit button. BUG: changing the amount after that updates the PayPal title (Pay $275.00) but the order is still for the $55 card. /groups/book: same stale-amount bug. After reserving with the deposit ($196.35), clicking Full changes the title to 'Pay $785.40' but the booking/order is still the deposit. Home Love Beach card shows $20.00 per person and links to /taxi?book=port-love-beach. The taxi modal dropdown has Love Beach, but the 'Pick your destination' fare-check widget (/api/taxi/locations) does NOT. The lightbox has no share button and /wall has no save/share/copy buttons. Regression: /payment/success shows 'You're all set!' with the QR, /pass shows the QR, and google-wallet-add-btn is absent. No payment was completed and no PayPal pop-up was opened. All TEST_/test_ data was removed.

minor.issue: Love Beach is not in the location list, so the /taxi 'Pick your destination' fare-check widget (RouteQuoteWidget) can't quote Downtown/Cruise Port → Love Beach ($20) or Paradise → Love Beach ($40).

ui_bugs.issue: Stale amount: after 'Continue to PayPal' creates the pending gift code, the amount, theme and recipient fields can still be edited and the PayPal title updates (e.g. 'Pay $275.00 with PayPal'). The PayPal order is still created from the original card (e.g. $55 for a $50 card), so the guest is told one amount and charged another. Fix: clear paypalCode when amount, custom, theme or form change, or lock the form once the code exists.

Stale amount: after reserving the GRP booking (deposit $196.35), the guest can still toggle groups-pay-full, change pax or change the date. The title then shows 'Pay $785.40 with PayPal' but the backend order charges the deposit stored on the booking. Fix: disable the quote/pay-mode/pax inputs while paypalBooking is set, or reset paypalBooking on change.

On the first cold page load, the PayPal SDK throws an unhandled 'zoid destroyed all components' error. The CRA dev overlay ('Uncaught runtime errors: Script error') covers the page and the PayPal buttons don't render. This happened on 3 of 3 fresh browser sessions on /pay/CB-6N6MRQ26; reloads work. Likely cause: React.StrictMode double-mount destroys the zoid component while the SDK is still loading. It may be dev-only, but preview users see it. Possible fixes: render PayPalButtons only after usePayPalScriptReducer isResolved, hoist PayPalScriptProvider to App level, or add an unhandledrejection guard that swallows this specific zoid error.

integration_issues.issue: Love Beach is missing from the From/To selects (backed by /api/taxi/locations). The booking modal dropdown and the destination cards do include it.

issues: Zelle email is clipped ('roxfam2509@gmail.c') and the phone number wraps in the 2-column grid. Use a single column or break-all.
The time input sticks out past the modal's right padding by about 18px on desktop.
These use the browser's native datetime-local picker instead of the shadcn DateTimePicker used in the booking modal.
Dropoff is not prefilled with Love Beach even though the route is Downtown → Love Beach.

action_items: GiftCards.jsx: reset paypalCode (or lock the form) when the amount, theme or form changes after the PayPal code is created, so the displayed total always matches the order
GroupsBook.jsx: disable the pay-mode, pax and date inputs once paypalBooking is set, or clear paypalBooking on change, so the title amount matches the deposit/full order
PayPalPayButtons: stop the cold-load 'zoid destroyed all components' crash/overlay (gate PayPalButtons on isResolved, or hoist the provider)
Add Love Beach to /api/taxi/locations so the fare-check widget quotes the $20 and $40 routes
Minor: Zelle email clipping on /pay; time input overflow in the booking modal; remove the dead payMethod==='paypal' (PayPal.me) branch in BookingFlow.jsx submit
critical_code_review_comments: BookingFlow.jsx is 1708 lines and still contains a dead paypal.me branch (payMethod==='paypal').
gift_card_purchase with pay_with=paypal leaves 'pending' gift docs whenever a buyer abandons the flow. Consider a TTL or cleanup.
group_booking_checkout applies the gift_code on create before PayPal is paid. If the guest abandons, the gift balance stays deducted (same behaviour as Stripe; confirm a release path exists).
PayPal transactions for group deposits don't store pay_mode='deposit' the way the Stripe path does. Harmless today because _mark_paid only special-cases 'balance', but it is inconsistent.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (all requested items render; 2 HIGH stale-amount bugs + cold-load PayPal crash + Love Beach missing from fare widget)

seed_data_creation: None kept. Created and deleted: gift cards (test_buyer@, test_gbuyer@), GRP bookings (test_group@, test_grpui@ GRP-768825F) plus 1 PayPal tx, and booking 2794E4E9 (test_pp@). Also removed two leftover TEST_sms@example.com zelle bookings from earlier iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe and PayPal are LIVE: never click the PayPal buttons. /tmp/clean.py-style cleanup deletes test_* bookings, transactions and gift cards. Groups date input is datetime-local; 10 pax at $80 base gives a $196.35 deposit and $785.40 full. To check PayPal render, count iframe.component-frame.visible inside [data-testid=pay-paypal-buttons] about 10s after load; the first cold load fails with a zoid error. The home guest strip moves constantly, so click photos via JS.
rca of the issue: Stale amount: GiftCards and GroupsBook compute the displayed total from live form state (giftTotal/dueNow), but the PayPal order amount comes from the server document created at submit time. After submit nothing invalidates paypalCode/paypalBooking, so the two can diverge. Repro: /gift-cards → $50 → PayPal → fill the form → submit → click $250 → the title reads $275 but the order would be $55. Cold-load PayPal crash: PayPalButtons mounts, StrictMode unmounts it and calls buttons.close() while the zoid render is still pending, and the rejected promise is unhandled, which triggers the CRA overlay; on a cold cache the remount doesn't recover.
